---
name: Bibliography or evidence proposal
about: Suggest a source that materially improves a decision rule, boundary or evaluation
title: "[Evidence]: "
labels: evidence
---

## Target skill and decision

Which skill and which concrete decision, safety rule, diagnostic branch or output contract would improve?

## Source

Link to the primary, official or otherwise authoritative source. Do not paste copyrighted text.

## Why this adds something

What gap, ambiguity, outdated guidance or counterexample does it address? Explain why this is more than generic model knowledge or a duplicate of existing guidance.

## Proposed original synthesis

In your own words, describe the small rule, caveat, calculation or source update you propose. Include uncertainty and applicability limits.

## Verification path

How could a maintainer check the source or evaluate whether the proposed change improves the skill?

## Checklist

- [ ] I have not included unlicensed third-party text, private material or personal data.
- [ ] The source has a clear relationship to a decision or testable behavior.
